The Pre-Litigation Paralegal Assistant plays an essential role in supporting the pre-litigation legal team by ensuring case files are accurate, complete, and well-organized throughout the early stages of litigation. This position works closely with paralegals and attorneys to manage medical records, billing documentation, liens, and settlement-related materials that directly impact case readiness and outcomes. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, patient with follow-up-driven tasks, and comfortable handling complex documentation while maintaining consistent communication with providers and clients. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, persistence, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced legal environment. Candidates who enjoy structured case support work and contributing behind the scenes to successful resolutions will thrive in this position.

title: Data Analyst
description:
As a Data Analyst in the Business Analytics team, you’ll be the dedicated analyst for our B2B commercial direction. You’ll work as an independent contributor, side by side with the commercial team. You’ll find growth opportunities in the data, form and test hypotheses, and measure the impact of business initiatives that are not product features. Your first projects will be supporting and developing our pricing override and cost modifier processes, designing experiments around the credit limits we give B2B partners to help grow their booking volumes, and evaluating the financial and customer impact of opening local legal entities in new markets. A/B testing alone often isn’t enough here, so you’ll choose and apply other methods, such as difference-in-differences or causal impact. There is no ready-made playbook. You’ll set your own approach, and project managers on both sides will help you run the work. The role suits a self-driven analyst who wants real ownership and visible impact on commercial decisions, and it can grow as the direction expands.
Requirements

• 2+ years of experience in business, data or product analytics.

• Strong SQL, including writing efficient, fast-running queries.

• Confident Python and its data libraries: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn and others.

• Hands-on experience with difference-in-differences.

• Experience with causal inference methods: Causal Impact, Propensity Score Matching and similar.

• Solid knowledge of statistics and experience designing and running A/B tests and other experiments.

• Ability to dive deep into business processes, solve non-standard problems and work independently.

• Fluent Russian and English B2.

Nice to have

• Experience with time series forecasting (Prophet, ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing or similar).

• Experience in B2B, commercial or partner analytics.

• Experience onboarding or mentoring junior colleagues.

• Hands-on use of AI tools, such as Copilot or agents, to speed up your work.

Benefits

• Flexible schedules and opportunity to work remotely.

• Ambitious and supportive team who love what they do, appreciate each other, and grow together.

• A structured onboarding, a personal development plan, and regular internal lectures and demos from the team.

• Internal programs for adaptation and training, development of soft skills, and leadership abilities.

• Partial compensation for participating in external training and conferences.

• Corporate English school: Group and individual lessons, speaking clubs with colleagues from all over the world.

• Corporate prices on hotels and travel services.

• MyTime Day Off - an extra non-working day without loss of compensation.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Systems Administrator to independently support and administer Windows and Linux systems within secure enterprise environments. This role is responsible for day-to-day system operations, advanced end-user support, troubleshooting issues beyond documented Tier 1 procedures, maintaining approved configurations, and owning technical issues through resolution or appropriate escalation.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Administer, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Windows and Linux workstations and systems.

• Independently diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, application, authentication, and network connectivity issues.

• Perform user, group, permission, service, file-system, and enterprise authentication administration using approved processes.

• Create, maintain, and improve SOPs, technical documentation, and repeatable administrative processes.

• Partner with Cybersecurity, Engineers, and other technical teams to resolve complex issues and maintain secure system operations.

• Provide technical guidance and support to Junior Systems Administrators as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Active TS/SCI security clearance.

• Active CompTIA Security+ certification or higher DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

• Working knowledge of Windows system administration and troubleshooting.

• Working knowledge of Linux administration, command-line tools, permissions, services, and troubleshooting.

• Experience with Active Directory or comparable centralized identity and authentication services.

• Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, subnetting, and network troubleshooting.

• Experience independently troubleshooting systems using logs, diagnostic tools, and technical documentation.

• Familiarity with PowerShell, Bash, or similar administrative scripting.

• Ability to work independently within established security requirements, SOPs, and configuration baselines.

• Strong documentation, communication, troubleshooting, and customer-service skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization technologies.

• Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, or specialized technical applications.

• Experience in DoD, government, classified, or other regulated computing environments.

• Additional Microsoft, Linux, VMware, networking, or security certifications.

title: Lead Analytics Engineer - Data Modeling & Quality
description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world - one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.
We’re a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable-and we’re looking for passionate people to help us get there.

For more information, visit .

Why This Role Is Important to Arcadia

Arcadia 's data platform powers population health analytics for health plans, ACOs, and provider groups across the country. As a Lead Analytics Engineer - Data Modeling & Quality, you sit at the intersection of data quality ownership and analytical data modeling. You'll own the SQL and DBT layer that transforms raw clinical and claims data into trusted, production-grade datasets, while also serving as the quality authority for the data those models produce.

This is a hybrid role - deeper SQL and DBT expertise than a traditional Data Health Professional, with a more analytical and model-focused scope than a Data Engineering role. You're less focused on pipeline infrastructure and more on the logic, shape, and trustworthiness of the data itself.

What Success Looks Like

In 3 months

• Independently triage and resolve pipeline data quality issues

• Author at least one new DBT model or refactor an existing one to meet current modeling standards

• Design a DBT test suite for a set of models lacking coverage

• Understand the end-to-end pipeline from ingress through silver and gold, and be able to trace a data quality issue to its root layer

In 6 months

• Building strong working relationships with clients and cross-functional partners (Data Engineering, Customer Success)

• Deeply familiar with Arcadia 's full data stack - from ingress through silver, gold, and downstream consumers

• Driving at least one improvement project forward, whether technical (e.g. model refactor, new DQ framework) or process-focused (e.g. promotion playbook, triage workflow)

In 12 months

• Recognized as a leader within the department - peers and stakeholders seek out your expertise on data modeling and quality

• Operating independently across the full scope of the role with minimal guidance

• Two or more improvement projects completed and in production, with measurable impact on data quality or operational efficiency

What You'll Be Doing

DATA MODELING & DBT DEVELOPMENT

• Author, review, and maintain DBT models using Spark/Hudi from ingest through bronze and silver

• Help clients understand their data model, assumptions, and limitations through intentional validation

• Troubleshoot and fix issues, then write DBT tests to catch issues proactively

• Optimize SQL performance for slow-running jobs

• Partner with Data Engineering on Hudi table design, partition strategy, and incremental patterns
DATA QUALITY OWNERSHIP

• Triage and classify data quality alerts, distinguishing source-level issues from transform-layer failures

• Design and maintain volume monitors and DQ monitors (null rate, distribution, future-date checks)

• Author and apply clinical DQ rules (entity volume, field coverage, LOINC coverage, referential integrity) and claims validation rules across silver and gold layers

• Conduct quality reviews for connector promotions - evaluating silver entity coverage, validation rule pass rates, and bronze-to-silver transformation correctness

• Own the ticket queue for DQ, attribution, hierarchy, and customer-specific data quality issues, writing clear customer-facing findings
CROSS-FUNCTIONAL QUALITY COLLABORATION

• Lead data quality reviews during connector installation and promotion (UAT → PRD), including claims validation playbooks and null analysis

• Partner with Data Engineering on root-cause triage for errors, ingress anomalies, and silver table issues surfaced through data quality monitoring

• Coordinate with the Measure

About the role
We are hiring an Application Security Engineer to build how our enterprise secures software, from first commit to production. This is not a role for running scans and filing tickets. You will design the guardrails, automation, and AI-powered tooling that let engineering teams ship securely by default, and you will prove they work with data.
You will work as a peer to engineering, architecture, and DevOps leaders and own outcomes across secure SDLC, CI/CD and supply chain integrity, WAF/WAAP and API protection, and AI/LLM security. The right person sees a recurring problem and builds the capability that makes it go away.

This is where careers are made!

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our CSM team has grown to five Customer Success Managers, each running a book of customers through ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX, NIS 2 and DORA. As the team keeps growing, we're creating a dedicated Team Lead role: a manager who works alongside the CSMs every day and makes their coaching and development a priority!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead the CSM team

- Line-manage the CSMs: regular 1:1s, structured feedback, input to performance reviews and individual development plans

- Own onboarding for new CSMs so they're productive on their first accounts fast

- Allocate books and manage capacity across the team as customers and CSMs are added

- Run a team health review covering at risk accounts, renewals and onboarding blockers

- Own customer escalations within the CSM books

- Own the CSM playbook and keep it current

- Decide which CSM workflows to automate, and build the agents and automations with AI

Drive the team's upsell performance

- Coach CSMs on spotting and running framework and service upsells within their books

- Keep the team's upsell pipeline clean and be accountable for the team's upsell number

Run your own portfolio

- Manage customers end to end: implementation, audit readiness, ongoing compliance, and upsell within those accounts

- Stay close enough to the day-to-day work that your coaching is grounded in it

ABOUT YOU

- You've managed or formally coached CSMs before for at least 1 year and want to keep doing it; this isn't a first step into management

- Structured and direct in feedback; you can run a hard performance conversation without the Head of CS in the room

- You work well in a written-first remote team: clear specs and updates over meetings, high ownership, low need for synchronous oversight

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in compliance, information security or GRC (ISO 27001 or TISAX in particular)

- You've built or reworked a CSM onboarding programme before

- You've worked in a fully remote team of a similar size

3. Take-home challenge

4. Challenge interview with Kuba and Fabiola, our CEO

5. Culture interview with Grigory, CTO

6. Meet for a final lunch in-person with Kuba (we'll fly you!)

WHAT WE OFFER

- Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather.

E11 Bio is on a mission to advance connectomics towards the scale of whole mammalian brains. We are a collaborative and interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers engaged in a neuroscience moonshot project to develop a radical technology platform for scalable brain mapping. About the Team

OpenAI's mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The U.S. Policy and Partnerships team sits within Global Affairs and helps translate that mission into trusted, practical engagement with civil society, community leaders, researchers, and other external stakeholders across the United States.

Our current operating model is built around disciplined, cross-functional campaigns: moving from abstract persuasion to local proof, pairing policy expertise with real-world use cases, and working with trusted validators who can help communities understand, shape, and benefit from AI. The team works closely with colleagues across Global Affairs, Legal, Safety, Communications, Product, Research, and other functions to build relationships that are substantive, durable, and grounded in two-way learning.

About the Role

As the U.S. External Affairs Manager, you will lead a portfolio spanning civil rights partnerships and federal AI policy, working with team leads to shape and advance OpenAI's engagement with civil rights organizations, civil society groups, researchers, community-based organizations, and federal policymakers. This role combines independent strategic ownership, policy judgment, and external representation to help shape the AI policy debate in the United States.

This role is central to the team's partnership and outreach operating model. You will help identify priority stakeholders, design engagement strategies, and build the external relationships and feedback loops. The work is not about one-way education; it is about co-design, listening, product and policy learning, and creating concrete proof points that can strengthen public trust.

Reporting to the External Affairs Lead, you will work across the U.S. Policy and Partnerships team and in close coordination with State and Local Policy, Federal Affairs, Communications, Safety, Legal, Product, and Research. OpenAI is evolving quickly as we release new research, products, and tools. Day-to-day work may include representing OpenAI at convenings, designing a stakeholder strategy around a fast-moving policy issue, organizing partner briefings, preparing product and policy explainers, supporting local proof-point campaigns, coordinating quarterly partner reviews, or translating feedback from civil society into actionable insights for internal teams.

This role is based in Washington, DC and may require frequent travel to meet with key stakeholders. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

- Develop and lead federal AI policy initiatives within your portfolio in partnership with Federal Affairs, connecting civil society priorities, community feedback, and practical use cases to OpenAI's policy positions and advocacy.

- Build and maintain trusted relationships with civil rights, civil society, research, community, education, accessibility and other stakeholder organizations relevant to OpenAI's U.S. policy priorities.

- Help execute a repeatable engagement operating model grounded in co-design, localized benefits, trusted validators, cross-functional planning, and regular partner reviews.

- Develop stakeholder maps, engagement plans, briefing materials, and follow-up systems for priority policy campaigns and rapid-response moments.

title: Labour Procurement Manager
description:
Labour is one of the largest cost areas across Rohlik Group, and external workforce services are critical to the daily performance of our fulfilment centres and warehouses.

As we continue to scale across Europe, we are establishing a dedicated Labour Procurement role within Group Procurement to bring stronger commercial ownership, transparency and consistency to this strategically important category.

We are looking for a Labour Procurement Manager who will own the sourcing and commercial strategy for external workforce services across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary and Romania. You will report to the Head of Group Procurement.

This is a build role, not an inherit role. You will shape the category strategy together with the Head of Group Procurement and then own its execution: running tenders and negotiations, establishing the commercial governance and introducing scalable, data-driven and AI-supported procurement processes.

Your work will have a direct impact on operational continuity, cost efficiency and the performance of our fulfilment centres.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- You will take ownership of one of Rohlik Group’s largest and most business-critical spend categories.

- You will build a new Group procurement function and shape how external workforce services are sourced and managed across five markets.

- Your work will have a direct impact on operational continuity, cost efficiency and the performance of our fulfilment centres.

- You will lead high-value tenders and negotiate directly with senior executives of staffing and workforce providers.

- You will work at the intersection of Finance, Operations and HR, with significant visibility across Group and local leadership.

- Rohlik is an AI-first company, giving you the opportunity to introduce automation, analytics and AI-supported tools across sourcing, contracting and supplier management.

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

- Own and execute the Group’s procurement strategy for external workforce services supporting our fulfilment centres and warehouses across all markets.

- Run tenders and lead negotiations at executive level; contract through the Group’s standard procurement and contract management tooling.

- Own the commercial architecture and cost governance of the category: benchmark provider pricing across markets and sites, drive cost transparency, and deliver measurable savings against a spend baseline you establish.

- Establish supplier performance management: service levels, quality, and delivery against contract, with regular scorecard reviews with providers and internal stakeholders.

- Embed AI, digital procurement tools, and analytics to create full visibility of category spend and automate sourcing and contract lifecycle processes.

- Monitor provider market trends, labour regulation, and pricing across CEE and DACH to future-proof the Group’s operations.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

- 5+ years in procurement, category management or a commercial role, ideally with exposure to agency labour, temporary staffing or outsourced services.

- Proven track record running large tenders and negotiating labour or service contracts at executive level.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills: you think in unit cost, service levels and total cost, not just contract value.

- Ownership and autonomy: you set your own priorities, move work forward without close supervision and know when to escalate.

- Strong command of AI and digital tools in procurement, including automation, analytics and contract management systems.

- Excellent stakeholder management: you will operate between Operations, HR, Finance, and provider executives, often with conflicting interests.

- English is required (C1+); Czech or Slovak is an advantage.

- Nice to have: Working knowledge of temporary agency work legislation and labour cost mechanics; comfort operating across CEE and DACH regulatory environments.

We are base in Fort Lauderdale, FL and have been in the supplement business for over 10 years.
The Role
We’re looking for a hands-on Email Marketing Assistant who knows Klaviyo inside and out. You’ll build and run campaigns and flows across several brands, fix technical problems when they come up, and keep our email calendar on schedule. That means writing copy and briefing designers yourself so nothing waits on someone else.
Most importantly, we want someone who wants to grow with us long-term. Our brands are scaling, our team is tight-knit, and we invest in people who invest back.
This isn’t a “push send” role. One day you’ll troubleshoot a broken flow trigger, the next you’ll write a promo email and brief our designer on the creative, and the day after you’ll rebuild a segment that’s been pulling the wrong people.
What You’ll Do

• Build, launch, and optimize automated flows in Klaviyo: welcome series, abandoned cart and checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, replenishment, winback, and sunset flows. Also manage subscription-related flows like failed payments, cancel-winbacks, upcoming billing reminders and more.

• Handle technical fixes and troubleshooting: broken triggers, flow filters, conditional splits, dynamic content and template tags, custom properties and metrics, and Shopify and subscription-app integrations

• Write email copy (subject lines, preview text, and body) that fits each brand’s voice and our compliance guidelines

• Brief graphic designers on new campaigns and emails: write clear creative briefs, assign tasks, manage turnaround, and review final assets

• Keep the list healthy and deliverability strong: list hygiene, suppression, engagement-based segmentation, and monitoring inbox placement

• Report on campaign and flow performance (revenue, conversion, click rate, unsubscribes) and recommend what to test next

• Work closely with our Retention & Lifecycle Manager to carry out the monthly promo calendar and product launches

Requirements

• Fluency in English, written and spoken

• Available during business hours, 8 AM to 5 PM EST

• 3+ years of hands-on Klaviyo experience, ideally for DTC e-commerce, CPG, or supplement brands

• Deep technical Klaviyo knowledge: flow logic, conditional splits, segment building, dynamic content and template tags, custom properties, and integration troubleshooting

• Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email

• Experience with Klaviyo and Shopify integrations; experience with subscription apps is a plus

• Strong copywriting skills, with the ability to write in several brand voices

• Experience briefing and managing designers or creative contributors

• Solid understanding of deliverability basics (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, list hygiene, engagement-based sending)

• Comfortable reading performance data and turning it into next steps

• Organized and self-directed, able to manage several brands and deadlines at once

•
Nice to have: Klaviyo SMS experience, Klaviyo certification, or experience in a regulated or compliance-heavy product category. Experience in the kratom niche is a plus.

description:
About the Team

At OpenAI, our User Safety & Risk Operations (USRO) team helps protect our products and users from abuse, fraud, safety risks, and other forms of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role sits on the Risk Incubation & Systems (RIS) vertical in USRO, which investigates emerging risks, builds data and automation capabilities, and develops workflows that can scale into durable operational homes.

About the Role

As part of the Automation & Analytics function within RIS, you’ll partner with teams across USRO to support their data, analysis, measurement, and automation needs. You’ll build tools and workflows that help teams make informed decisions and improve how they operate. You’ll work with domain experts to turn judgment into testable criteria, then help take promising prototypes into reliable operation.

You will work hands-on with Trust & Safety domain experts, investigators, operational leads, and engineers to turn ambiguous requirements into practical systems. You’ll test and document the tools and workflows you build, and agree with partner teams who will monitor and maintain them.

Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.

In This Role, You Will

- Work with teams across USRO to define the questions they need answered and identify work that could benefit from automation.

- Use SQL and Python to investigate operational problems and turn findings into recommendations teams can act on.

- Build and maintain datasets and dashboards that teams can use for recurring analysis.

- Define metrics to assess the quality and impact of USRO’s work, and measure whether changes produce the expected improvements.

- Build scripts and API integrations to automate recurring tasks, using LLMs where they improve the workflow.

- Evaluate automated workflows against expert-reviewed examples and existing processes to understand errors and measure their practical value.

- Hand off workflows with clear ownership, maintenance instructions, and a feedback loop for reviewers.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

- Have strong SQL skills and can use Python to analyze data and build tools that solve practical problems.

- Have worked with messy (operational) data and can assess its quality and explain how gaps affect your findings.

- Can turn a loosely defined request into a clear problem and choose a practical way to solve it.

- Have built and maintained datasets, dashboards, scripts, or API integrations that other people use in their work.

- Know how to define useful metrics and measure whether changes to a process or tool improve outcomes.

- Can explain the trade-offs involved in workflow automation, including where human judgment is needed.

- Can work with domain experts to define clear assessment criteria and work through disagreements about ambiguous cases.

- Have experience designing evaluations or quality checks and using the results to decide when to launch a tool and how to improve it.

Nice to Have

- Experience transferring prototypes or new workflows into reliable, scaled operations.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Product
description:
ABOUT REBAR

Construction is a $2 trillion industry in the US alone. Most of it still runs like it’s 1995: PDFs, spreadsheets, and email.

Every commercial building starts the same way. Someone opens a few hundred pages of blueprints and counts every piece of equipment, duct, and pipe by hand. Then they price it, bid it, and chase it for months. That work decides who builds what, and for how much. It has barely changed in 30 years.

Rebar is building the AI platform the trades run on. Our models read blueprints the way a veteran in the trades does. Our agents then do the work that follows: counting the job, pricing it, managing the bid, and tracking it through to the order. Counts that took three days now take one. Customers spend hours a day in Rebar, and thousands of new plan sets flow through it every week.

We started with HVAC contractors and their suppliers. Every other trade comes next.

Here’s where we go: when a building goes up, the trades that build it run on Rebar. Agents win the job, run the job, and buy the equipment.

We’re about 50 people in Union Square, growing fast, and backed by top investors. We’ve built only a fraction of what we need to.

ABOUT THE ENGINEERING ORG

The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware, and we're being intentional about adapting with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. Our core values are:

- Everyone operates like an owner

- Find a way

- We win together

That being said, the whole company still works really hard! This is something that you should read and internalize. This might not be the place for everyone.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a software engineer to be the technical arm of our Client Success and Implementation teams.

As we sign bigger customers, every deployment comes with more technical work attached. A contractor wants their historical projects loaded in. Another wants our analytics piped into their ERP or BI tool. Another needs an API change, so their internal systems can pull takeoff data. Today, that work lands on the core engineering team as one-off requests, pulling them off the roadmap. We want one engineer who owns it.

You will still sit in the engineering org and have strong mentorship and learning. You'll come to engineering stand-ups, ship through our normal review process, and attend retros. Your priorities come from our customers.

You can think about this role almost as a forward-deployed engineer. You'll be on calls with customers, figuring out what they actually need and then building it. You’ll get to work with messy data, API integrations, and customer expansion.

We understand the challenges and sacrifices that come with joining an early-stage startup, and we want to emphasize that we're committed to ensuring you leave as a better, more experienced engineer and leader than when you joined. Here you'll own a hard piece of client-side engineering, and watch it scale from hundreds to thousands of users.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own customer data work

- Build and maintain integrations

- Handle customer API requests

- Scope technical requirements with customers

- Be the escalation path for technical issues

- Turn one-offs into product

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We want an engineer who likes talking to customers. You should be able to sit on a call with an estimator, understand how their team works, and then go write the script that fixes their problem. You'll be working with messy real-world data, so you should enjoy digging into it and not be scared of a 50,000-row CSV with inconsistent columns.

We are looking for engineers with good judgment, an inquisitive attitude, and the maturity to represent engineering in front of a customer.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years of software engineering experience, or a technical client-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation engineer, forward deployed engineer) where you wrote real code

It spreads to the next brand, the next market, the next forty teams. So winning a new logo and growing it into a company-wide program are not two jobs. They are one machine, and you design it.

Much of that machine is still to be built. You won't inherit a funnel someone else drew and be told to hit it. You write the demand strategy with Tom Husson, our CMO, and you lead the team that runs it: our ABM Acquisition Lead, ABM Expansion Lead, Head of Global Events and Head of Digital Strategy, plus field marketers in the US, UK and APAC and a New Media Lead. Some seats are filled. Some are yours to hire.

And you get an edge most demand leaders never have: our own product. Before you spend a dollar on an offer or a message, you can put it in front of real buyers through Conveo and hear exactly what they think.

YOUR MISSION

1. WRITE THE DEMAND STRATEGY, AND MAKE EVERY PLAN TRACE BACK TO IT

Start from the buyer, not the channel.

- Map each audience's journey, from the first time a senior insights or marketing leader hears our name to the tenth team inside their company

- Decide which channels serve each stage, so we create demand with buyers who aren't looking yet and capture it the moment they are

- Agree it with Tom, revisit it every quarter, and change the mix when the data says so

2. OWN THE PIPELINE NUMBER, AND MAKE IT ONE SALES AND FINANCE PLAN ON

Five times the bookings target, built backwards and reported straight.

- Plan backwards from bookings with Sales and Finance, by segment and region

- Report weekly in the numbers RevOps uses, forecast monthly, and call it early when the plan drifts

- Know your conversion rates by stage and segment, and pull them yourself

3. MAKE EVERY PAID DOLLAR PROVE ITSELF

Every program is an experiment with a stop number.

- Set paid strategy across LinkedIn, search and new channels with your Head of Digital Strategy

- Measure what is truly incremental with holdouts and lift tests, then fund what proves pipeline and stop what doesn't

- Move budget in weeks, not quarters

4. WIN THE BIGGEST ACCOUNTS, THEN TAKE THEM FROM ONE TEAM TO MANY

This is where Conveo's growth compounds.

- With your two ABM leads and our account teams, open new enterprise logos and spread Conveo across brands and markets inside the ones we already serve

- Choose focus accounts together with Sales, who have the final say

- Build plays good enough that account teams start asking for them by name

5. TURN EVERYTHING WE SHIP INTO MEETINGS

We ship product every week, and our customer stories and research are some of the strongest evidence in the category. None of it should end as just a blog post.

- Give every launch, conference, dinner and post a target audience and a follow-up path that ends in a meeting with the right person

- Decide with the teams who make content where each piece goes, measure which pieces turn into pipeline, and feed that back into what gets made next

- Close every major launch, event and content piece with a pipeline readout

6. BUILD A TEAM THAT HITS ITS NUMBERS AND OUTGROWS ITS ROLES

- Set clear targets for each of your leads, and coach them to hit them

title: Project & Commissioning Engineer
description:
About Tempo

Based in San Diego, California, Tempo develops thermochemical energy storage (TCES) systems designed for energy-intensive industries. The platform enables industrial operators to shift energy use over time by sourcing power when it is most cost-effective and enables the electrification of high-temperature industrial heat at a cost advantage to using fossil fuels. By storing electricity thermochemically, the system delivers a continuous stream of combustion-free, high-temperature air at up to 1,200°C.

Tempo is backed by leading climate and energy investors, including Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, and Prelude Ventures.

For more information, visit www.tempoenergy.com .

Position Overview

We are seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Project Engineer with 5+ years of engineering experience to join our multidisciplinary Applications Engineering team, supporting project execution. This role serves as a primary technical bridge between front-end detailed design and field execution, taking engineered and modular process systems from concept through construction and field startup. The role will be responsible for the development of project documents, and ensuring successful field deployment of projects.

The ideal candidate blends strong technical documentation capabilities (PFDs, P&IDs, and SolidWorks) with a rigorous understanding of instrumentation and project execution. This individual should possess direct, field-based commissioning and startup experience.

Core Responsibilities

• Detailed Design & Engineering Deliverables

• Develop, update, and manage engineering process drawings, including Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), mass/heat balance tables, and Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs).

• Utilize SolidWorks to modify and review 3D project layouts, equipment arrangements, structural frames, and pipe routings.

• Instrumentation & Equipment Specification

• Author, review, and finalize instrumentation and equipment datasheets for process systems (e.g., control valves, pressure relief valves, flowmeters, level transmitters, temperature elements, and process equipment).

• Coordinate directly with instrument and equipment vendors to review technical quotes, evaluate bids against project specifications, and review vendors calculations.

• Generate Instrument lists, I/O lists, and junction box wiring drawings.

• Support development of control narrative for heat offtake applications.

• Project Coordination & Vendor Management

• Support the Lead Project Manager in tracking engineering schedules, procurement lead times, equipment expediting, and budget adherence.

• Interface closely with multi-discipline teams (mechanical, structural, electrical, and automation) to resolve technical and scope gaps.

• Witness and sign off on Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) at vendor facilities, verifying dimensional accuracy, wiring continuity, and mechanical assembly against engineering drawings.

• Onsite Commissioning & Startup Execution

• Lead and support field pre-commissioning checkout, commissioning, and handover activities at customer operating facilities and job sites for our demonstration projects.

• Execute point-to-point wiring checks, cold and hot loop checks, valve stroking, instrument calibration verifications, and interlock/safety shutdown testing.

• Lead onsite mechanical completions: pressure testing, punch-list creation and closeout, and leak-check verifications.

• Provide direct engineering support during startup, tuning, and operational performance testing.

• Actively enforce field safety procedures

Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

• Experience: 5+ years of post-graduate engineering experience working in design, fabrication, or field execution roles within process industries.

• Ability work onsite in San Diego 5 days a wee

ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

We are looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to join our team in Mexico City and support our Global talent organization. Our team is responsible for bringing the very best talent to Watershed in order to power the teams working to accelerate the climate economy. It's a rare opportunity to channel your skills into solving one of the most challenging and impactful problems of our generation. We value individuals who are excited to own the coordination process while always striving for excellence and a world class candidate experience.

This position is a 6 month contract with the goal of converting to full time. It is based in our Mexico City office 4 days per week.

YOU WILL:

- Schedule complex phone, virtual, and in-person interviews working across multiple time zones with multiple recruiting partners

- Have strong attention to detail with proven operational and systems thinking

- Have proven ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a high-demand environment while demonstrating professionalism

- Are excited to use AI to drive efficiencies

- Are curious and comfortable with ambiguity

- Are an excellent verbal and written communicator in English and Spanish

- Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to contribute to doing so at a fast-paced startup

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. title: Senior HR Business Partner (f/m/d)
description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry - we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

YOUR ROLE

Growing a fusion company across two continents means building people processes while the teams that use them are still changing. Department leaders need someone who understands their business, asks the right questions, and helps them make people decisions that move the business forward.

As our Senior HR Business Partner, you help department leaders decide how their teams grow, develop people, and manage performance. You will learn how the fusion business works so your advice reflects what teams actually need. No prior fusion experience is required.

This is a hands-on role. You will build people processes while teams are growing and priorities are shifting, and you will own those processes from design through rollout and follow-through. Business leaders remain accountable for their teams. You will work closely with Talent Acquisition, People Operations, and other HR Business Partners. People Operations handles routine HR administration, so your time goes into partnering and building.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Advise department leaders on how to structure and grow their teams. Ask questions to get to the root of a problem, bring options and a recommendation, and follow the decision through.

- Lead the rollout and ongoing improvement of performance reviews and career frameworks. Work with the People team to keep role levels, promotion decisions, and compensation bands consistent as the company grows.

- Coach managers on setting clear expectations, giving direct feedback, and having difficult conversations.

- Handle employee relations and conflict with empathy and sound judgment, and know when to escalate.

- Work with Talent Acquisition on hiring priorities and decisions, and with People Operations and fellow HR Business Partners to coordinate support from hiring through development, promotion, and departures.

- Use people data to explain what is happening in teams, connect it to business outcomes, and recommend what leaders should do next.

WHO YOU ARE

- Experience as an HR Business Partner through rapid growth in a deep-tech or engineering-heavy organization, helping leaders make decisions when priorities shifted and processes were still being built.

- Hands-on experience building people processes, not just running established ones. You can explain what you personally designed and implemented, such as performance reviews, career leveling, or compensation bands.

- Strong knowledge of German employment law and GDPR, and a practical understanding of People Operations, including how contract types and payroll deadlines affect decisions.

- The ability to ask diagnostic questions, coach leaders, and give clear advice without lecturing.

- Comfort with data: you use people data to make a clear recommendation and can tell the story behind it.

- Comfort with ambiguity: you can build from scratch, prioritize quickly, and keep moving when processes are incomplete.

- Humility and curiosity when entering an unfamiliar industry.

- Ownership and a low-ego approach: you are willing to do the hands-on work yourself.

- Fluent in German and English.

- Based in Darmstadt, or willing to relocate, with the ability to be in the office three days a week.

Nice to have:

- Experience in both a high-performing large company and a scale-up.

- Experience working with technical and scientific leaders, such as in engineering, physics, or operations.

- Experie

AT A GLANCE

You'll win new advertisers and turn their first campaigns into growing, long-term partnerships with Almedia. You'll own the journey from prospecting and closing to campaign launch, optimization, and initial scale-up.

This is a hands-on sales role with clear revenue ownership. Closing the deal is the starting point: you'll learn Almedia’s products in depth, understand what drives campaign performance, and help advertisers build the confidence to commit larger budgets.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 🎯

- Win new business. Identify and engage advertisers, and publishers. Build your pipeline through targeted outreach, referrals, industry events, and your network.

- Own the first campaigns. Coordinate setup and launch with advertisers and internal teams. Agree on test budgets, performance targets, measurement, and clear criteria for scaling.

- Optimize and scale. Monitor early campaign performance, identify what limits delivery or returns, and take action. Use Almedia’s internal tools to adjust campaign settings and ROAS targets, working with Growth and algorithm teams to improve results.

- Turn results into larger budgets. Translate campaign data into clear recommendations. Secure budget increases, expand into new geographies or operating systems, and move successful tests into sustained spending.

- Solve problems early. Spot underdelivery, attribution discrepancies, or performance issues before they damage advertiser confidence. Coordinate resolution and keep the advertiser informed.

- Deliver revenue targets. Take responsibility for new advertiser acquisition and the revenue generated as their initial campaigns scale. Prioritize opportunities with meaningful commercial potential.

- Keep a reliable forecast. Maintain an accurate pipeline and a clear view of launch readiness, campaign progress, and expected budget growth.

WHAT YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS LOOK LIKE

- Days 1-30: Learn Almedia’s products, sales process, and campaign optimization fundamentals. Shadow sales and campaign reviews, build your target-account list, and begin outreach.

- Days 31-60: Own discovery calls, pitches, and proposals. Build a qualified pipeline and work alongside experienced Growth Managers on campaign setup, performance analysis, and optimization decisions.

- Days 61-90: Close your first advertiser partnerships and own their initial campaign launches. Identify performance improvements, make optimization recommendations, and secure budget increases where results support scaling.

- Beyond 90 days: Build a repeatable record of winning advertisers and growing their spend. Take on larger opportunities and contribute to Almedia’s commercial growth.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING 💡

- A record of winning business. You've acquired customers, negotiated agreements, and delivered measurable revenue results in sales, business development, or a commercially focused growth role.

- The drive

- Fluent German and English. Business-level (C1) German is a must.

WHY LIO

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Y Combinator, with a $30M Series A and offices in Munich and New York. We’re winning, and every employee is a shareholder, so you win with us. You’ll work with some of the smartest, most driven and unconventional people in Europe, and no two weeks look the same.

On top of that, you get a brand-new office at Stiglmaierplatz, catered dinners, a subsidized Wellpass or Deutschlandticket, team events like Wiesn, parties to celebrate our wins, 30 days of vacation, and the latest equipment.

Sounds like you? Let’s talk.

Job Title: In-Home Physician Part Time - Bend
Job Location: Work at Home, Oregon, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD
Part-time employees qualify for:

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

The Workplace Operations Sr. Manager is responsible for facilitating an exceptional office experience, providing operational support with a strong focus on customer service. You will work in collaboration with key stakeholders within and outside of the Workplace team to provide and maintain a top tier facility and employee experience. You are an individual who thrives in a fast paced evolving environment, who possesses strong communication skills, and the ability to successfully prioritize and exec ute tasks. You have a growth and development mindset, know how to stay self-motivated and lead with a positive attitud e.

• Manage and foster professional development for the Bay Area Operations team.

• Facilitates an ongoing delightful employee experience by providing operational support and maintaining a well organized, visually pleasing facility.

• Manages, maintains, and enhances the Workplace programs (ex: mailroom operations, janitorial, food and beverage, etc.).

• Builds an active relationship with business partners and leaders to assess team allocations and occupancy needs as well as conference room usage. Provide proactive solutions, and improvement ideas through observati on.

• Perform building audits to verify employee locations, furniture layout and room configurations are correctly noted in the space management tool.

• Coordinate with the Space Planning to maintain space standard ratios for on/offline rooms and office standards and solutions, as well as define spa ce related programs to improve team member experience, as well as facilitate office moves.

• Facilitates and maintains relationships with building vendors, such as landlord, food and beverage partners, etc.

• Maintain budgets and track expenses for multiple different areas of the business.

• Acts as the single point o f contact for all building related issues.

• Facilitates connecting employees to all aspects of the broader Verkada Business Operations teams.

• Other site specific duties and support may be required.

What You Bring

• A passion for providing exceptional customer service through human connection and ongoing operations support.

• 7+ years of management experience or related project management experience.

• 7+ years of workplace services experience.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build relationships across departments, work collaboratively.

• Strong organizational and planning skills, ability to prioritize and manage multiple tas ks, projects, and e ver-changing priorities.

• Purpose-driven learner with an active growth mindset, continuously seeking feedback to grow as a teammate and engineering partner.

title: People Analytics, Security & Integrations Lead
description:
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.
We're looking for a People Analytics, Security & Integrations Lead to join our global HR Operations & Technology team. You'll set the strategy for how we use Workday Reporting & Analytics worldwide and turn people data into insights for senior leaders. You'll also own Workday security and the integrations that connect Workday to our other systems. You'll work with HR teams across APAC, Europe and the US, and you'll mentor members of the People Analytics team.

What you'll do

People analytics (primary focus)

• Define and implement a global data strategy and roadmap for Workday Reporting & Analytics, including standards for how teams build and use reports.

• Analyze structured and unstructured data (employee surveys, exit interviews, applicant tracking, and more) to find patterns in recruiting, hiring, turnover and compliance, and turn them into clear recommendations.

• Build and support self-service dashboards, scheduled reports, worksheets, and custom and ad hoc queries in Workday.

• Use AI to speed up analysis and streamline reporting and other processes.

• Deliver reporting and insights to the CEO and staff, the Board of Directors and other key stakeholders.

• Work with other organizations to agree cross-functional data definitions and consolidate data.

• Coach and mentor People Analytics team members.

Workday security and integrations (secondary focus)

• Own Workday security design and maintenance, including security groups, domain and business process policies, and role-based access.

• Support access reviews, audit requests and privacy controls, and keep sensitive HR data protected and compliant.

• Test security after Workday releases and sandbox refreshes.

• Build and maintain Workday integrations using EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors and Workday Orchestrate.

• Own vendor integrations (for example payroll, benefits, ATS and SSO): monitor them, troubleshoot failures and work with vendors and IT to fix issues.

• Document integration designs and keep run-books current.
